'''''Glimmers of the Pattern''''' is the title of two different chapters in ''[[The Wheel of Time]]'' series:

* The [[The Great Hunt/Chapter 11|eleventh chapter]] of ''[[The Great Hunt]]''.
* The [[Crossroads of Twilight/Prologue|prologue]] of ''[[Crossroads of Twilight]]''.
